steps.name: Step 1 — Open a pipeline (create form) and fill Name + Description
Step 2 — Confirm the "Welcome message" section is visible/expanded
Step 3 — Fill the welcome-message textbox: 'Hello! How can I help you today?'
Step 4 — Click Save; verify create succeeds (2xx) with no console errors/warnings
Step 5 — Open a new chat session: full-page reload of the detail page for a pristine load
Step 6 — Verify the welcome message appears automatically, alone, before any user input
